QUOTE: The asm paths are gated by `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` (`constant_time_impl.h:42`). That needs `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM`, which is on in the shipped `mbedtls_config.h:52` and off in `configs/config-symmetric-only.h`, plus `__GNUC__` or `__ARMCC_VERSION`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM needs MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler macros, but it never says it is derived rather than a user-configured entry in mbedtls_config.h, so that point is left implicit.
